summary: Frontend-only verification of the onboarding recurring-payment bug fix on GigTax (Expo web preview, AU, server date 2026-08-14, current BAS quarter 01/07/2026–30/09/2026). All three requested cases PASS. (1) Happy path: fresh profile → 5-step onboarding with ownership-rental, recurring-toggle ON, rec-amount 280, freq-weekly, anchor-gigstart, rec-anchor-date 01/07/2026 → 'Start driving' → landed on /home which shows '$1,800.00 owed this quarter' (matches expected ~$1,700-1,800 range for 45 days at $280/wk × 100% business default). Reports → tab-reports → period-quarter (01/07/2026 – 30/09/2026) shows Vehicle deduction card with 'Recurring payment (calculated) $1,800.00' annotated '$1800 gross × 100%', Vehicle deduction total $1,800.00, Total deductions -$1,800.00 and NET PROFIT -$1,800.00. Recurring payment is applied and NOT $0 / NOT ~$40. (2) Negative case: same onboarding but rec-anchor-date left BLANK → tapping onboarding-next ('Start driving') did NOT navigate; URL stayed at /onboarding and Step 5 of 5 was still visible with the Recurring-payment fields intact. Recurring was not silently dropped — the finish() guard blocks the transition when the anchor date is missing (line 55 of onboarding.tsx). (3) Vehicle expense: from Home used home-add-expense entry-amount=220, category vehicle, dated 15/08/2026 (within current Q) → Reports Quarter now shows Vehicle costs $220.00, Recurring payment (calculated) $1,800.00, Vehicle deduction total $2,020.00, Total deductions -$2,020.00, NET PROFIT -$2,020.00 — logged vehicle expense is included and correctly apportioned at 100% business (no trips). No pageerrors and no red-box during the run. Pre-existing non-blocking console warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' (carried over from iteration_1/2/3, unrelated to this fix).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warning still observed: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Pre-existing from prior iterations, not caused by this bug fix.

action_items: None blocking — the recurring-payment bug fix is verified working. Optional: migrate remaining pointerEvents={...} prop usage to style.pointerEvents (carried over).

Optional UX polish: in the blank-date negative case the transition is correctly blocked, but the toast is transient — consider also inlining a persistent error hint on the rec-anchor-date Field so users on slower devices don't miss the toast.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx finish() (lines 47–71) correctly (a) parses amount and shows toast + returns if !amt, (b) resolves chosen anchor as auToISO(recAnchorDate) for gigstart or acqISO || auToISO(recAnchorDate) for acquisition, and (c) shows 'Enter when the payment started (DD/MM/YYYY)' toast + returns when chosen is empty — so recurring is never silently dropped and the router.replace to /(tabs)/home only runs after updateProfile succeeds.
Anchor prefill: switching Count from = 'Vehicle acquisition' after typing acqDate correctly copies acqDate into recAnchorDate (line 244) — good.

Reports proration verified end-to-end: weekly $280 × (2026-07-01 → 2026-08-14, 45 days) prorated to $1,800 and displayed as '$1800 gross × 100%' annotation with Vehicle deduction total updating additively when a vehicle expense is added ($1,800 + $220 = $2,020). Math and UI wiring are correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 3 requested scenarios verified: happy-path recurring rental ~$1,800 in Q, negative blank-date block, and logged vehicle expense apportioning.

seed_data_creation: Each case used a fresh localStorage.clear() + reload → onboarding. Byproduct at end of run: 1 profile with ownership=rental, recurring $280/wk from 2026-07-01, and 1 vehicle expense of $220 dated 2026-08-15.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding step order: onboarding-next → worktype-delivery → onboarding-next → platform-Uber → onboarding-next → ownership-rental → onboarding-next → recurring-toggle → rec-amount → freq-weekly|freq-fortnightly|freq-monthly → anchor-gigstart|anchor-acquisition → rec-anchor-date (DD/MM/YYYY, auto-masked from digits) → onboarding-next ('Start driving'). Reports tab testID is 'tab-reports' (not 'text=Reports' — that ambiguously matches the 'Reports' heading and can miss the tab). Reports period chips: period-week/month/quarter/year. Home shows recurring 'owed this quarter' inline card with the recurring $ amount. Server 'today' is 2026-08-14 so BAS Q is 01/07/2026–30/09/2026. Fresh browser session = new local profile, so each test case can be isolated by localStorage.clear() + reload.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: onboarding recurring-payment anchor date defaulted to TODAY (or was silently accepted as blank), so a $280/week rental only counted ~1 day (~$40) for a whole quarter, and if anchor was invalid the recurring block was silently dropped on save — appearing as 'not applied'. Fix in /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx finish(): (a) no default anchor to today, (b) prefills recAnchorDate from acqDate when 'Vehicle acquisition' chip is picked, (c) explicit guards — show toast + return if amount missing OR if chosen anchor (after auToISO parse) is falsy, blocking navigation to home instead of silently dropping recurring. Reproduction (before fix): onboard rental, toggle recurring ON, amount 280, anchor 'Gig-work start', leave payment start date blank → finished onboarding but Reports Quarter showed $0 recurring. Verified after fix: (1) with valid past date 01/07/2026, Reports Q shows Recurring $1,800.00 (matches ~45-day proration) and Home shows $1,800.00 owed this quarter; (2) with blank date, finish() is blocked, URL stays /onboarding, still on Step 5 — no silent drop; (3) logged vehicle expense $220 is added on top → Vehicle deduction total $2,020.00, apportioned at 100% business (no trips).
